title: Chapter 801
text:
'Galaxy' had already gone through two versions, and every Star Field was like an independent server with different main storyline events. The players' experiences and encounters were different, and they worked for different civilizations and met different people.

Although the events in the various Star Fields were different, the general trend of the versions was the same.

In Version 1.0, the players were born on the novice planet and experienced events on the planet. In Version 2.0, they experienced the turmoil of the novice planet and received the guidance of different factions, officially stepping into the universe and adventuring within the Star Systems. In Version 3.0, the stage of the players gradually expanded to the Star Cluster they were in and went deeper into the universe.

The professional clubs of the various countries chose different Star Fields as their headquarters to make it easier to obtain resources, thus attracting the normal players within the country. The Constellation Corridor was mainly the home ground of the professional players from Russia and Australia, and there were also some clubs from smaller countries. Of course, the normal players were not limited to this. They could choose any Star Field to start in, and even the Shattered Star Ring had many international friends. The Constellation Corridor also had players from various countries.

The players there had experienced the rebellion on the novice planet Sodrian. This planet was originally a remote fief of a Star System civilization, and due to historical factors, it had been an autonomous region for a long time. The ruler of the planet had his own army, and because this person was involved in a sensitive matter, he was suppressed by the Star System civilization in Version 2.0. The ruler of Sodrian was not willing to give up and openly resisted.

In the middle and late stages of Version 2.0, the rebellion was suppressed, and the civilization reclaimed Sodrian. The ruler led his fleet and escaped. Due to the intervention of external forces, the players entered the galaxy. Unlike the Black Star Corps in the Shattered Star Ring, the players of the Constellation Corridor went their separate ways. Some were recruited by the Star System civilizations, some escaped with Sodrian, and some became free people and traveled the universe. The various civilizations scattered in the surrounding Star Systems were divided into many factions, completely different from the situation in the Shattered Star Ring.

In Version 3.0, because the Constellation Corridor was the headquarters of the Red Empire, almost all the civilizations were controlled by the Red Empire, and they did not dare to cause trouble. Therefore, unlike the Star Fields outside the Central Galaxy, there were very few conflicts between civilizations. A few months after the start of the version, the secret war main storyline in the Shattered Star Ring had already been completed. The players of the Constellation Corridor had only just triggered the main storyline and had just gotten online with a Star Cluster civilization.

It was precisely because of the large number of factions and good security that the players here sought for their own entertainment and advocated PVP. This led to frequent guild wars, snatching resources and territory from each other. Because Russia and Australia coexisted here, ordinary players from both sides took the initiative to treat each other as an opposing faction. They fought each other merrily, and it was very lively.

For the convenience of communication, the players would always tacitly allow the existence of public areas, forming a group effect. The largest safe area recognized by the players of the Constellation Corridor was a trading planet called Gilman in the initial Star Cluster. It was extremely prosperous and was also a stargate transit station, so it was convenient to travel. Many players set up stalls and requested to form parties there, treating it as a public area.

The Black Star Corps Division was located on Planet Gilman.

This day, as usual, many players took galactic flights to Planet Gilman from other places and queued up at the spaceport of the planet. The spaceship queue extended out like a river of light, and it was quite crowded.

The vice president of the Strength and Glory guild, 'Vodka', and many other guild members were in one of the spaceships. This guild was the official guild under the most famous club in Russia, and their goal was to provide resources for the club's' Glory 'team. However, some of the Chinese players preferred to call them the' White Emperor Sacred Sword 'team.

Vodka had brought people to do missions in other civilizations and collected a batch of equipment. This time, he returned to Planet Gilman to rest and store this batch of equipment in the guild base's warehouse on Planet Gilman.

A guild officer walked into the room and reported to Vodka, "The captain has sent a notice saying that there's a problem with the identity check of the fleet ahead. We'll have to queue for about ten minutes before we can enter."

"Thank you." Vodka nodded.

Everyone was not surprised. They opened the interface and browsed the forums while waiting.

Vodka did the same. He browsed the forums and saw many posts about the Black Star Corps. He shook his head and could not help but say, "The Black Star Corps has been talked about for half a month. I wonder if they're really going to open a division in the Constellation Corridor."

Hearing this, the crowd began to talk.

"We can't even get in touch with the Red Empire now. Who knows if the Black Star Corps have arrived. They've been received by the Empire Ruler, and their level is so high. We probably won't meet them."

"That's right. Even if they're going to open a division, we might not even meet them. Who knows where they'll appear."

Currently, the Constellation Corridor players had not joined the Red Empire yet, and Han Xiao did not bring any players over. The Black Star Corps came directly from the mother planet of the super-large Stargate Empire, and there were no witnesses. Due to the lack of information, the Constellation Corridor players had no way of knowing what the Black Star Corps was doing.

Just as everyone was chatting, someone casually glanced out of the porthole, and his face suddenly froze. He turned around and stared out of the window with a shocked expression.

"What's that?"

Everyone was stunned. They all looked over and were equally stunned.

They saw a fleet escorting a huge mobile satellite base out of the stargate not far away and slowly approaching Planet Gilman. Not only Vodka and the others, but all the players and galactic residents lining up outside the spaceport saw this scene.

On the hull of the fleet, the logo of the Black Star Corps was engraved. The Constellation Corridor players recognized it as well.

"The Black Star Corps?"

"They actually appeared here?!"

Under the shocked gazes of everyone, the satellite base of the Black Star Corps slowly stopped outside the atmosphere of Planet Gilman and sent out a fleet to negotiate with the planet's guards.

Seeing this scene, Vodka was stunned for a while. Suddenly, he exclaimed in surprise, "Wula! Could it be … the Black Star Corps is going to open a division on Planet Gilman? "

Hearing this, the faces of the surrounding guild members changed, and they were overjoyed.

Not long after, the news of the army's arrival spread throughout Planet Gilman. The players on the surface could see the satellite base outside the atmosphere when they looked up. Their eyes widened in excitement.

Very soon, the army finished negotiating with Planet Gilman. Because of the identity of the army commander and the authority given by the Red Empire, Planet Gilman did not have the right to reject the army's request for a division to be stationed there. They could only send people to help the Black Star Corps set up the base.

Immediately after, while the players were waiting in anticipation, the army finally officially announced to the world that they would be establishing a division there!

As soon as the news came out, it swept through the forums like a hurricane. The players of the Constellation Corridor were all shocked.

After half a month of anticipation, the Black Star Corps had really appeared in another Star Field. Everyone had made all sorts of guesses about how the Black Star Corps would interact with them, but no one would have thought that the Black Star Corps would directly descend on their main city-like public area!

The reaction of the players was directly reflected in the forums. The topic of the army appearing on Planet Gilman instantly rose to the top of the trending topics of the Constellation Corridor!

The anticipation of the past half a month turned into flames of excitement, igniting the passion of all the players!

This was the first inter-Star Field faction to come into contact with the Galaxy players. Even the forums of the other Star Fields were filled with excitement.

Especially the Shattered Star Ring.

…

In the Shattered Star Ring, in the bustling Black Star Corps headquarters, countless players stopped in their tracks at the same time and opened the forums.

"The army has crossed Star Fields!"

"The forums over at the Russian side have exploded in an instant! Let's go join in the fun! "

"Haha, let those foreigners experience what it's like to be in our army."

"Although we're separated by Star Fields, we might be on the same side in the future."

"Tsk, don't you think this is called recruiting members?"

The players of the Shattered Star Ring were excited. They spontaneously went to the forums of the Constellation Corridor and made a post there. The title and reply were all 'Welcome foreign friends to the army'. In just a few minutes, this post was stacked by almost a hundred thousand Chinese players!

"Black Star Corps headquarters sent a congratulatory message."

"Shattered Star Ring sent a congratulatory message."

"Welcome Bear Race and Kangaroo Race to the Black Star Corps!"

"Welcome newcomers. Remember our slogan — Army Leader is awesome!"

It felt like they were exploding other people's forums.

From Version 1.0 to Version 3.0, the Black Star Corps was deeply rooted in the hearts of the people. Seeing their own growth-type faction develop to such an extent, many players of the Shattered Star Ring felt gratified and proud. They felt like they had finally raised a child after going through so much trouble.

Mad Blade, Pork Bun, Maple Moon, and many other players who had met Black Star in the beginning felt even more deeply. They had been through so many ups and downs with the Black Star Corps, and those memories seemed to surge into their minds.

So, they had come so far …

They had mixed feelings.

The operation of the Black Star Corps this time seemed to be the beginning of a new era in their eyes. Maybe this was the starting point of the players being able to cross Star Fields. Maybe one day in the future, all the Galaxy players would be able to gather in the same Star Field. It was from this moment.

…

The army division was officially established on Planet Gilman, and its influence on the players of the Constellation Corridor immediately appeared. Almost all the players who were doing missions outside turned around and rushed to Planet Gilman from the various Star Systems.

Ever since they entered the galaxy in Version 2.0, there had never been a situation where all the players gathered in the Constellation Corridor. This time, due to the appeal of the army itself and the commotion caused by crossing Star Fields, almost everyone was attracted by the Black Star Corps and gathered from thousands of miles away!

With a wave of the arm, the leek cloud came!

The army division opened the port and announced on the quantum network that the division had just been established and needed to recruit a large number of people. The specific details could be found on the army's homepage.

This was because the players of the Constellation Corridor did not have a sense of belonging to the army. What attracted them were the benefits and fame of the army. With the example of the Shattered Star Ring, almost all the old players knew how good the benefits of the Black Star Corps were. Han Xiao's operation in the three versions had given the army a very high status among the players.

After reading the recruitment information on his communicator, Vodka blew his nose and sighed. "The benefits are too good …"

Salary, bonuses, faction specialties, internal services of the army, a large number of mission resources, the benefits of the Black Star Corps were much better than any of the factions that the players of the Constellation Corridor had experienced so far!

Especially the faction store, which was the most attractive. Han Xiao had accumulated a large number of low-grade blueprints and given them to the logistics department to mass produce over the years. Now, the army sold more than ten thousand types of machinery and equipment, which could be categorized in the store. Basically, there would always be one that suited you. There were also customization, repair, enhancement, and other value-added services. Other than that, there were also many Dungeon Crystals, gene potions, manufacturing materials, and other miscellaneous items, as well as various financial group products from other channels. The army's faction store was like a trading hub. There was a dazzling array of products.

"Vice President, are we going to join the Black Star Corps?"

"Let's go to their division." Vodka was very tempted. Not to mention the attractive benefits of the army, just the fact that the Black Star Corps was an ally of the Red Empire was enough to dispel his hesitation.

Vodka took the guild members to a spaceship and headed to the army's division in outer space.

They entered the dock, got off the spaceship, and followed the bionic robot receptionist to the hall. The hall was filled with a sea of people, and it was extremely crowded. At this time, almost all the players who stayed on Planet Gilman ran over.

There were many large guilds among them, and Vodka saw many of his old rivals. They were all familiar people who had fought in guild wars in the past.

Everyone was here to join the army, so they needed to submit their resumes and participate in the test. The main purpose was to test their combat strength. Other than the new players, almost all of them were Grade C, so this recruitment threshold was nothing.

Vodka squeezed all the way to the center of the hall. In front of him was a door that led to the combat test rooms. Groups of players lined up there, waiting for their turn to be tested.

Vodka and the others waited for a while, and finally, it was their turn. A mission popped up on the interface.

Faction Mission: Black Star Corps Test

Mission Introduction: The rise of the Black Star Corps is filled with legends. It is now a super large organization in the Shattered Star Ring, an ally of the Red Empire. Now, the Black Star Corps has crossed Star Fields, recruited soldiers, and built a division in the Central Galaxy. You have received the opportunity to join the army. However, the members of the army have to go through a strict selection process. If you want to join this faction with endless potential, you have to prove your strength …

Vodka and the others did not suspect anything. Another group of players walked into the combat test room with their heads held high.

…

At the same time, somewhere in the Constellation Corridor, there was a bustling tourist planet.

This was a planet with almost no traces of artificial modification. It had beautiful mountains and clear waters, blue seas and blue skies, and large patches of vegetation covering the surface. The vegetation here would emit a faint fluorescent light at night, making it look like a dream. All kinds of beautiful and gentle creatures lived on the surface of the planet. Occasionally, groups of small silver beasts could be seen floating in the air between the dense forests. They were like swimming fish that took the air as the sea.

"This planet is really beautiful …"

Han Xiao and the others passed by this planet and stopped to take a look. The spaceship floated high in the sky, and the group gave up on flying. They slowly walked in the forest at night, and all they could see was beautiful scenery.

Aurora liked the smell of nature very much. It was full of vitality, and she walked at the front. Ames, Hella, and the other Black Star Guards were in the middle, looking left and right to enjoy the scenery. Han Xiao walked at the back with his hands behind his back, looking at the backs of the others with a smile on his face.

After smelling too much of the smell of engine oil and metal, breathing in the fresh air now felt like it was cleansing his lungs. He could not help but feel refreshed, and he started to hum a tune.

Hella slowed down and retreated to Han Xiao's side. She glanced over and said, "You seem to be in a good mood today."

Han Xiao's lips curled up, and he chuckled.

Today, he had finally raised his sickle to the ripe leeks in other people's fields. How could he not be happy?
